name: Occupational Personality Questionnaire OPQ32r
description: SHL's flagship personality questionnaire. Assesses workplace behavioural style and role fit against the Universal Competency Framework, based on 40+ years of validation research across 20+ countries.

name: OPQ User and Managers Report
description: OPQ output report pairing a candidate-facing User Report (profile chart and narrative) with a Manager's Report describing personal working style, intended to support feedback conversations.

name: OPQ Team Types & Leadership Styles Profile
description: OPQ-based report mapping an individual's preferred team role (Belbin team types) and leadership/reporting style (Bass), used for team composition and leadership development.

name: OPQ Universal Competency Report 2.0
description: OPQ-derived report mapping personality to the Universal Competency Framework, showing which competencies are likely helped or hindered by an individual's working style.

name: OPQ Manager Plus Report
description: Concise OPQ report for use by and with line managers, summarising personality traits in bullet and table form for quick interpretation.

name: OPQ Maximising your Learning Report
description: OPQ development report summarising an individual's preferred approach to learning across four dimensions, used to tailor training and development plans.

name: OPQ Emotional Intelligence Report
description: OPQ-based report exploring how a person manages their own feelings and relationships with others, intended for use in development settings.

name: OPQ Candidate Plus Report
description: Brief narrative OPQ report written to be shared directly with the candidate who completed the questionnaire.

name: Verify - Deductive Reasoning
description: Measures the ability to draw logical conclusions from information provided, identify strengths and weaknesses of arguments, and complete scenarios using incomplete information. 18 minutes, 20 items.

name: Verify - Numerical Ability
description: Next-generation numerical reasoning test measuring the ability to derive numerical problems from written information, calculate answers, and interpret numerical data in a realistic work context. 20 minutes, 16 items.

name: Verify - Inductive Reasoning (2014)
description: Assesses the ability to identify patterns in data or situations and generalise them to broader contexts. Used for candidates at all levels who need logical reasoning ability.

name: SHL Verify Interactive - Inductive Reasoning
description: Mobile-first, interactive version of the inductive reasoning test. Evaluates the ability to identify specific patterns in data or situations and generalise that information to broader contexts.

name: Following Instructions v1 - US (R2)
description: Measures a candidate's ability to follow detailed instructions and select the correct course of action, presenting a set of rules and asking for the appropriate response to various situations.

name: Spring (New)
description: Multiple-choice knowledge test covering Spring core, AOP (aspect-oriented programming), the IOC container, and transaction management.

name: Marketing (New)
description: Multiple-choice test measuring conceptual knowledge of marketing principles, market research, consumer behavior, brand management, sales management, channel management and advertisement management.

name: Python (New)
description: Multiple-choice test measuring knowledge of Python programming, databases, modules, and libraries.

name: Data Warehousing Concepts
description: Measures knowledge of data warehousing: big data and appliances, business considerations, data transformation, marts, dimensional data modeling, OLAP, and querying/reporting/data extraction.

name: ReactJS (New)
description: Multiple-choice test measuring technical knowledge of React APIs, the render function, JSX, form validation, and styling.

name: Enterprise Java Beans (New)
description: Multiple-choice test measuring knowledge of Enterprise Java Beans (EJB), EJB types, transactions, and concurrency.

name: Core Java (Advanced Level) (New)
description: Multiple-choice test measuring knowledge of basic Java constructs, OOP concepts, file/exception handling, and advanced Java topics such as generics, collections, threads, strings, and concurrency.

name: Java 2 Platform Enterprise Edition 1.4 Fundamental
description: Measures basic J2EE 1.4 fundamentals covering business component development, J2EE architecture, JAX 1.2, JDBC 3.0, supporting APIs, web component development, and web service development.

name: VB.NET (New)
description: Multiple-choice test measuring knowledge of VB.NET assemblies, OOP concepts, ADO.NET, multithreading, exception handling, and GUI development.
